en.headline: About 73,000 subdivided units have applied for registration
en.dek: The housing secretary said 42 units had completed certification, and 528 light-public-housing households had been allocated public rental flats.
body: About 73,000 of Hong Kong's roughly 110,000 subdivided units have applied for registration under the basic-housing regime, Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said on Saturday.

Speaking on radio, Ho said the applications amounted to nearly 70 per cent of known units and described the pace as better than expected. She said 42 units had completed certification, and that owners could register first and decide later whether to keep operating. Tenants who run into problems can contact district service teams, and mediation bodies have been asked to offer voluntary mediation if disputes arise among owners, sub-landlords, tenants and contractors, she said.

On transitional housing, Ho said 528 households in light public housing had so far been allocated public rental flats, which she said showed the units were turning over. She said the present stock of light public housing was sufficient for now. Commercial Radio separately reported her figure of about 73,800 registration applications, or about 68 per cent.

zh.headline: 約7.3萬個分間單位已申請登記
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，42個單位已完成認證，528戶簡約公屋住戶已獲編配公屋。
body: 房屋局局長何永賢周六表示，全港約11萬個分間單位之中，已有約7.3萬個申請登記，接近七成。
何永賢在電台節目說，簡樸房登記進度比預期好，業主可先登記、日後再決定是否繼續營運。她說現時有42個單位完成認證。租客遇事可聯絡區域服務隊；制度涉及大業主、二房東、租客及裝修公司，局方已聯絡調解機構，有需要時可提供義務調解。
簡約公屋方面，何永賢說至今有528戶獲編配公屋，顯示單位有流轉，認為現時單位數目暫時足夠。商台另引述她的數字，指約7.38萬個單位已申請登記，約佔68%。
